objective: Anchor a network flow with role-safe tuple semantics, then expand time in bounded steps only while each wider window has expected information value and remains inside the trusted authorization envelope.
preconditions: a trusted alert timestamp and bounded authorization envelope exist
at least one attributable observable or event tuple exists
cross-sensor role semantics and deployed field catalogs are available
required_evidence: anchor window tuple role semantics and correlation key provenance
each attempted window with exact filters status hit count and coverage
successful query bounds truncation telemetry gaps and evidence references

query_templates.purpose: Establish the narrowest useful flow window around the trusted alert using only authorized observables and a role-safe event tuple.
Expand to a bounded cross-sensor timeline without changing authorized observables, tuple meaning, or the trusted outer time envelope.

alternative_hypotheses: a single expected client-server exchange explains the anchor
periodic maintenance discovery or monitoring explains repeated flows
sensor retention parser or asymmetric-routing gaps hide related activity
a sustained or recurring malicious sequence explains corroborated windows
stop_conditions: the anchor and discriminating temporal pattern are corroborated
a wider window repeats the same evidence without changing a hypothesis
the trusted authorization envelope would be exceeded
a query budget or deadline is exhausted
confidence_limiters: community ID or role-safe tuple attribution is unavailable
one or more windows are partial failed truncated or unavailable
sensor coverage or retention changes across attempted windows
known_false_positive_patterns: load balancers proxies and shared service infrastructure
